The team led by [[Tommy Lloyd]], in his 2nd season as a head coach. This is the Wildcats' 49th season at the on-campus [[McKale Center]] in [[Tucson, Arizona]] and 44th season as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–7, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish a tie in 2nd place. They defeated [[2022–23 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Stanford]], [[2022–23 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]], and [[2022–23 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] to become champions of the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 Tournament]]. They received an automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] where they were upset in the First Round by [[2022–23 Princeton Tigers men's basketball team|Princeton]], becoming the 11th No. 2 seed to lose to a No. 15 seed. ==Previous season== {{main|2021–22 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team}} In Lloyd's inaugural season, The Wildcats finished the 2021–22 season at 33–4.
